note: Modules may return ONLY these codes; a custom string is a protocol violation. `retriable` is a property of the code. `fatal` (must disconnect) is a property of the individual error and lives in C-01 §5, not here.
rules: message <= 300 chars; never echo keys, tokens or raw exception text across the process boundary.
FORBIDDEN is not a valid code (v1.1 task books used it); use PERMISSION_DENIED.
New codes require an RFC against C-04; the Rust enum in protocol/core is compared against this file by tools/check_contracts.py.
CODE_INVALID / CODE_EXPIRED never echo the submitted pair code.
AUTH_FAILED covers wrong password, unregistered key, bad signature and not-initialised alike (no oracle).
BUDGET_EXCEEDED (RFC-0005): [usage].enforce="block" and the session/day budget is exceeded with a trustworthy ledger. Not retriable — retrying spends more. `data` = {state, scope, used, limit}.
http_note: HTTP statuses are for the admin plane (C5a) mapping. The WS data plane uses the code inside JSON-RPC error objects; `http` is advisory there.
